facts.fact: 影织的下颚先咬进盖赫里斯的太阳穴，这个头部创伤让他再也无法施展以太术。
facts.anchor: Shadow-spun jaws sank into his temple first—a head wound, making it impossible for him to aethermance.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛心里只剩一句：阿拉里克杀了自己的父亲，她必须把他带离这里。
facts.anchor: Alaric had killed his father. She had to get him out of here.

facts.fact: 她求他别让她也死在这里，正如她不肯让他死在这里。
facts.anchor: “I can’t let you die here,” she pleaded. “So—don’t let me die here, either.”

facts.fact: 塔拉辛按阿拉里克紧绷的指示，把他拖进走廊深处摄政王的私人机库。
facts.anchor: Following Alaric’s tensely uttered directions, Talasyn dragged him into the Regent’s private hangar bay farther down the hall.

facts.fact: 利苏准将在凯萨斯全舰队频道上宣布摄政王已死。
facts.anchor: “Regent Gaheris is dead,” said the commodore.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛的光织化成七条咆哮的龙冲出舱井。
facts.anchor: The Lightweave spiraled out of her in the form of seven snarling dragons.

facts.fact: 巴昆从以太空间撕裂而来，一声尖啸震动群星。
facts.anchor: Bakun came tearing in from aetherspace with a grating scream that shook the stars.

facts.fact: 第一名内纳瓦伦人死去、越海海水翻涌之后，群龙升起。
